adjudicated.en: Misato: "Indeed. The demanded item impresses with its intelligence, it is tears as well as truth. Shall we not persistently strike the earlobe of listeners with the thoroughly refreshing good old youth culture resurrected by the hands, no, the voice of our Broadcast Club!"
comments: Technical, precise, slightly deranged and damn verbose - this was NVL until basically the fifth or sixth rewrite. Overliteral about the ears continues with "striking the earlobes", even funnier considering Mimi = ears. -GHS

adjudicated.remedy: Present the four required qualities clearly, then preserve the rhetorical proposal to revive a refreshing youth culture through the club's voices.
